```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Red Springs' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(rast, 1, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom), TRUE) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ST_Count(clipped_raster, 1)) AS total_pixels,
    SUM(ST_Count(clipped_raster, 1, TRUE)) AS above_280_pixels
  FROM clipped_dem
),
percent_above_280 AS (
  SELECT
    (above_280_pixels::float / total_pixels::float) * 100 AS percent_above
  FROM elevation_stats
)
SELECT percent_above FROM percent_above_280;
```
